_comment: Optional name-normalization dictionary. Keys are lowercase extracted candidate strings (Arabic or English), values are the EXACT Odoo customer name to use instead of fuzzy matching. Add entries here whenever you see a wrong/low-confidence match in needs_review.csv or on a created quotation's chatter note. This is just a data lookup — it does not change how any specific sender's email is parsed.

_note_naturestar: id 266 'ناتورستار للاستثمار' is our own company (Naturesta) under a slightly different spelling in Odoo, NOT a customer. It's already excluded from matching via own_company_keywords in config.json — no alias needed, it should never be created as an order.
